column1: P.T. LEE CNCET - ANNA UNIVERSITY GPA & CGPA AUTOMATED CALCULATOR
Automated Calculation Engine for Semester GPA (SGPA) and Cumulative CGPA with Working Excel Formulas
ANNA UNIVERSITY GPA / CGPA FORMULA SPECIFICATIONS:
Semester GPA (SGPA) = Σ (Credits [Ci] × Grade Point [Gi]) / Σ (Credits [Ci])
Cumulative CGPA = Σ (Semester Total Credit Points [Si]) / Σ (Total Credits Across All Semesters)
